body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> iWave(www.iwaveaudio.com) presented its iPhone/iPod accessories during CES 2010, which include earphones, iPhone/iPod cases and more. According to the company, these products will be available in 2Q, 2010 for around between $10 and $40.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
